result.summary: Rebased feature/WF03-ISS0179-20260821 onto origin/main (14 upstream commits, 0 conflicts). Opened PR #438, which merged via gh pr merge --squash --delete-branch -- the GitHub-side merge succeeded (confirmed via gh pr view: state MERGED, mergeCommit e0179f733fde4c054ab1c4c49367f9ab03f89292) but the local side-effect (checkout to main, delete local/remote branch) errored because this checkout had unrelated uncommitted local edits (this handoff file's own IN_PROGRESS status stamp, plus ORCH's untouched orchestrator.log/registry.json) -- same failure shape GIT_MERGE.md's worktree variant documents, just triggered by local diff instead of a worktree lock. Resolved by stashing the three uncommitted files, completing local cleanup (checkout main, pull --ff-only -- fast-forward b17cd91..e0179f7, branch -d), explicitly deleting the now-orphaned remote branch via gh api, then popping the stash back cleanly (no conflicts) so orchestrator.log/registry.json remain uncommitted for ORCH exactly as before.

issues.description: gh pr merge's local checkout side-effect failed with 'Your local changes ... would be overwritten by checkout' (not the worktree-lock error GIT_MERGE.md's worktree variant documents, but the same partial-failure shape) because this checkout held uncommitted edits to this handoff file and to ORCH's orchestrator.log/registry.json at merge time.
